# Sanitized QDDS scalar metadata from two real CISC AS/400 images.
# Format:
# LABEL COUNTS_SLICE_0x118_0x125 COMMON_ENTRY_LENGTH_0x13C_0x13F V2_LAYOUT_0x1E0_0x1EF
# These bytes contain counts/lengths only; no record payload is included.
QCLSRC_REFRESH2 0001000000470000004700000000 0000005d 000000000000005c00000000005d0000
PTFSUM_PTFSUM 0001000007950000079500000000 00000051 00000000000000500000000000510000
DBUUSERS_DBUUSERS 0001000000010000000100000000 00000017 00000000000000160000000000170000
PDPICKORG_PDPICKDEMO 0001000007580000075800000000 000001c5 00000000000001c40000000001c50000
B10_QLBLSRC_PROTO 00010000006b0000006b00000000 0000005d 00000000000000000000000000000000
